name: Carved Relief
description: Museum light on stone, bronze and terracotta: public-domain photographs of sculpture, vases and picture stones cut out and layered in 2.5D, with letter-spaced inscriptional capitals. Alternate look of the mythic-tale template for Greek, Roman, Norse and temple-sculpture stories.

tokens.texture: Stone grain, raking light vignette, soft contact shadows under photo cut-outs (Studio.kit.mythic.plate)
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; --gap; safe-area insets per format

motion.personality: Monumental and slow: a camera moving over objects in a gallery; parallax between cut-out photographs; no object performs
motion.notes: Photographs never bounce or squash. Use duotone on mixed sources so plates from different museums sit together.

contrast_checked: Below 4.5:1 (accent-3/paper 4.1:1): leaf, borders, shapes and display type 24px+ only; never body or caption text
suitable_for: myths and legends told through artefacts

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values with src/pipeline/colorscience.py (WCAG 2.x), 2026-11-23. Frame-reviewed in Playwright Chromium on Windows through the mythic-film scaffold; not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the M2 host.

avoid_for: stories with no surviving artefacts to show
